datasets.name: VhrAILM (very-high-resolution aerial-images-based landslide mapping)
datasets.verbatim: We construct a dataset of landslide mapping from very-high-resolution aerial images, designated VhrAILM.

datasets.name: CAS Landslide Dataset
datasets.verbatim: Experimental evaluations on our collated dataset, VhrAILM, and the publicly available CAS Landslide Dataset exhibit a strong robustness and excellent semantic segmentation performance.

methods.name: CSLMamba-LM (Mamba-based Causal Self-contrastive Learning Network)
methods.summary: A Mamba-based U-Net network for landslide mapping that integrates causal inference. It features a Cross-level Space and Channel Interaction Module (CSCIM) for feature interaction, Multi-scale Local Spatial Saliency Computation (MLSSC) for local landslide saliency, and an Attentional Causal Self-contrastive Learning (ACSL) paradigm for content-style decoupling to improve robustness and generalizability.
methods.source: Chengqiang Zhao, Shijie Chen, Jiashu Zhang
methods.verbatim: we propose a Mamba-based Causal Self-contrastive Learning Network (CSLMamba-LM) for the fine-grained landslide mapping from very-high-resolution aerial images.

availability.author_statement: Data will be made available on request.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory datasets are mentioned but not linked or made available, and the custom method code lacks a repository or persistent link.
